hints.title: Value Domain Constraint
hints.text: Node values are constrained to at most 50. Precompute all coprime pairs among values 1 to 50.

hints.title: Depth and Node History Stacks
hints.text: During depth-first traversal, maintain a stack of (node_id, depth) for each possible value from 1 to 50.

hints.title: Querying Closest Ancestor
hints.text: For node u, check all values coprime to nums[u]. The closest coprime ancestor is the one with maximum recorded depth.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

variables: N: number of nodes in tree
complexity.notes: At each node, checks at most 50 coprime candidate stacks, running in O(50 * N) time.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Walking all ancestors from u towards root takes O(N) per node, resulting in O(N^2) worst case.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Tracking ancestor stacks per value (1..50) provides O(1) query time for each value.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Exploiting small numerical upper bound with value-indexed ancestor stacks in DFS.

solutions.approach: C++ Backtracking Stacks over Value Domain
Java DFS with Ancestor Stacks per Number
